description: This file is a C header file defining structures, function prototypes, and macros related to object identification and context within a version control system, likely Git. It includes definitions for object contexts, functions for obtaining and abbreviating object hashes, and navigation of branch names.

methods.name: object_context_release
methods.description: Releases resources associated with an object_context, particularly the symlink_path buffer.

methods.name: repo_find_unique_abbrev
methods.description: Returns an abbreviated SHA1 string, unique within the repository, of specified length.

methods.name: repo_find_unique_abbrev_r
methods.description: Reentrant version of repo_find_unique_abbrev that writes to a provided buffer.

methods.name: strbuf_repo_add_unique_abbrev
methods.description: Adds an abbreviated object ID to a strbuf.

methods.name: strbuf_add_unique_abbrev
methods.description: Adds an abbreviated object ID to a strbuf.

methods.name: repo_get_oid_with_flags
methods.description: Gets the object ID from a reference string with specified flags, supporting object ID expressions.

methods.name: repo_get_oid
methods.description: Retrieves the object ID from a reference string.

methods.name: get_oidf
methods.description: Formatted version to get object ID from a printf-like format string.

methods.name: repo_get_oid_commit
methods.description: Retrieves the object ID for a commit reference.

methods.name: repo_get_oid_committish
methods.description: Retrieves the object ID for a commit-ish string.

methods.name: repo_get_oid_tree
methods.description: Retrieves the object ID for a tree object.

methods.name: repo_get_oid_treeish
methods.description: Retrieves the object ID for a tree-ish reference.

methods.name: repo_get_oid_blob
methods.description: Retrieves the object ID for a blob reference.

methods.name: repo_get_oid_mb
methods.description: Retrieves the object ID for an 'mb' reference (uncertain without context).

methods.name: maybe_die_on_misspelt_object_name
methods.description: Checks for misspelt object names and possibly terminates with an error.

methods.name: get_oid_with_context
methods.description: Retrieves object ID with additional context and flags.

methods.name: repo_for_each_abbrev
methods.description: Iterates over all abbreviations matching a prefix.

methods.name: set_disambiguate_hint_config
methods.description: Sets configuration for disambiguation hints.

methods.name: repo_interpret_branch_name
methods.description: Parses branch names with special syntax, supporting features like '@{-N}', upstream, and remote branches.

methods.name: repo_peel_to_type
methods.description: Peels an object to a specific type, given a name and an object.
